---
title: "Imatinib Concentration Response Curves"
author: "Marta Tomaszkiewicz"
date: "2025-10-24"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load data}
# Load dataset
screen.df <- read.csv("all_mutants_with_relative_viability.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

screen.df.slim <- screen.df %>%
  select("species", "IC50", matches("^X\\d+\\.rel\\.viab$"))
```

```{r format data}
# Pivot to long format
long_df <- screen.df.slim %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^X\\d+\\.rel\\.viab$"),
    names_to = "dose",
    values_to = "rel.viab"
  ) %>%
  mutate(dose = as.numeric(gsub("^X(\\d+)\\..*", "\\1", dose)))

# Assign color groups based on IC50 ranges

long_df$color_group <- cut(
  long_df$IC50,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 300, 600, 1200, Inf),
  labels = c("#ffffbf", "#2c7bb6", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
  right = FALSE
)
```

```{r plot data}
# Create the plot

plot <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = dose, y = rel.viab, group = species, color = color_group)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(10, 10000)) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    x = "Imatinib dose [nM]",
    y = "Relative viability",
    title = "Imatinib Concentration Response Curves"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Display plot in HTML

plot
# Save plots to files

ggsave("Conc_response_curves.png", plot, dpi = 600, width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
ggsave("Conc_response_curves.pdf", plot, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 600)

```
